call_points.text: FY26 volume growth was mid-single digits, with growth described as holistic across brands.
Neurobion and Livogen grew around 20%; Seven Seas early double digits; Nasivion and Evion high single digits.
Three FY26 launches contributed early single-digit points of growth to the overall business.
FY26 gross margin improvement came from productivity, favourable product mix and NPPA-permitted pricing.
Productivity programmes delivered ₹35 Cr of savings in FY26.
Exports grew in FY26 with 3X growth in Nepal and high single-digit growth in Sri Lanka.
Asked about Evion and Polybion declining in FY26 on IQVIA data, management gave no figure and pointed to doctor advocacy.
Management sees GLP-1 adoption as complementary, with VMS brands positioned alongside medical treatments.

operating_notes.text: Executed sale of immovable properties in Mumbai resulting in approx ₹32 Cr profit on April 30, 2026.
The Board recommended a final dividend of ₹45 per share for FY26 to be paid on or before September 25, 2026.
FY26 volume growth was mid-single digits, with sales up 16% and PAT up 30%.
The GTM model change added nearly 30,000 pharmacies and HCPs to coverage over the last 2-3 years.
FY26 productivity programmes delivered ₹35 Cr of savings; exports saw 3X growth in Nepal and high single-digit growth in Sri Lanka.

timeline.summary: Procter & Gamble Health executed an indenture of sale for Mumbai immovable properties to record an approximate profit of ₹32 Cr.
Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹370.45 Cr, net profit ₹94.6 Cr.

On its 18 June 2026 analyst call, P&G Health reported FY26 sales of close to ₹1,400 Cr (+16%) and PAT of ₹327 Cr (+30%), with mid-single-digit volume growth and ₹35 Cr of productivity savings, and gave no FY27 guidance.
